verdict.rationale: ChatGPT documents an official desktop app on macOS and Windows that runs projects, works with files, and supports voice and browser use. Computer Use lets it see and operate graphical interfaces, with screenshots covered by data controls, so screen access is clearly provided. A user also confirms using the macOS desktop app. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of OS-level global keyboard shortcuts or hotkeys (only floating Pets controls for typing or voice are mentioned), and independent hands-on corroboration of screen access.
